title: The normalized cubical model and its coordinate maps
statement: Let A be a commutative condensed ring, r a natural number, and D the discrete lattice. A CubicalModel consists of an equivariant cochain complex L, coproduct injections from the regular internal module indexed in degree n by lattice vectors and subsets of cardinality -n, the stated alternating cubical boundary and translation action, and an augmentation to the equivariant tensor unit. Its underlying origin section retracts this augmentation and is equipped with a chain homotopy from identity to augmentation followed by section. It further carries an integral degree-raising contraction satisfying the integral chain identity and whose finite coefficients recover that internal homotopy on every cell. No inhabitant of this structure is asserted here. The module also defines the invariant complex and its counit inclusion, total and tensor-cell summand maps, coordinate actions and invariant internal-Hom evaluation using the existing ordinary diagonal tensor. These are exactly the existing data and formulas of the parent interface.
